image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent Albertosaurus from the config library mid-stumble on the racetrack. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Slate-blue skin, navy racing stripes, red-tipped eye crests, and exactly TWO claws per hand. ACTION: The dinosaur has tripped over a large, smooth river stone, causing him to lose his balance in a dynamic, forward-pitching motion. One long leg is twisted awkwardly, and he's beginning to fall forward. His small, two-fingered hands are splayed out in front of him, trying to break his fall. NECK & HEAD: His head is thrown back slightly in surprise, mouth open in a comical 'gasp' of indignity. The red-tipped crests above his eyes are tilted. TAIL: The stiff, horizontal tail is suddenly angled upward, acting as a dramatic counterweight to his falling body. IMPACT: A controlled burst of dust sprays around his tripping foot. SETTING: The prehistoric dirt track with motion-blurred jungle. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3' with dynamic, physical comedy. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC'. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' side-profile to emphasize the awkward, yet still sleek, fall.
